### Twenty One Capital CEO Raphael Zagury to Speak at Bitcoin Treasuries Conference 2026 in New York City


September 21, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s21.q4cdn.com/307816567/files/doc_news/Twenty-One-Capital-CEO-Raphael-Zagury-to-Speak-at-Bitcoin-Treasuries-Conference-2026-in-New-York-City-2026.pdf)


*Session to be Livestreamed on the Bitcoin Magazine YouTube Channel*


AUSTIN, Texas--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Twenty One Capital, Inc. (“Twenty One” or “XXI”) (NYSE: XXI) today announced that Chief Executive Officer Raphael Zagury will speak at the Bitcoin Treasuries Conference 2026, taking place September 28, 2026 at SECOND in New York City.


**Bitcoin Treasuries Conference 2026 Details**


- **Date:** September 28, 2026
- **Venue:** SECOND, NYC, 849 6th Avenue, New York, NY, 10001
- **Speaker:** Raphael Zagury, Chief Executive Officer, Twenty One Capital
- **Website:**[https://bitcointreasuries.net/conference](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fbitcointreasuries.net%2Fconference&esheet=54607062&newsitemid=20260921069304&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Fbitcointreasuries.net%2Fconference&index=1&md5=73f5db351d5a453137cfec660e2114d3)


**How to Watch**


The session will be livestreamed on YouTube, available at[youtube.com/@timkotzman8925/streams](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.youtube.com%2F%40timkotzman8925%2Fstreams&esheet=54607062&newsitemid=20260921069304&lan=en-US&anchor=youtube.com%2F%40timkotzman8925%2Fstreams&index=2&md5=7eee63419b8dd2df0aad8d3b5643f059) . Additional conference information is available at[bitcointreasuries.net](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fbitcointreasuries.net%2F&esheet=54607062&newsitemid=20260921069304&lan=en-US&anchor=bitcointreasuries.net&index=3&md5=490a7620de613612bca755b05ec44743) .


Investors and members of the media interested in scheduling a meeting with Twenty One management during the conference should contactxxi@kcsa.com .


**About Twenty One**


Twenty One is a Bitcoin-focused operating company. Designed to pair one of the largest Bitcoin treasuries in the public markets with operating businesses, Twenty One aims to provide shareholders with direct, capital-efficient exposure to Bitcoin through a growing Bitcoin-native platform. For more information, visit[https://investors.xxi.money/](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.xxi.money%2F&esheet=54607062&newsitemid=20260921069304&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.xxi.money%2F&index=4&md5=f5b40a03143a74e87cac5654ca57e462) .
